_comment: Licence policy of the Sovereign Agentic OS - the ONE file scripts/license-gate.mjs reads.
Owner decision 2026-11-22, refined the same day. It covers the WHOLE repo: OS code, images, chart components, app templates
allow      - permissive licences: our own code and everything linked into it. SPDX ids, case-insensitive, exact.
exceptable - weak copyleft (weak: MPL, LGPL, EPL, CDDL) and GPL programs (gpl). NOT allowed by default: allowed ONLY through an entry in
licenses/exceptions.json that carries a reason, reviewedBy and a condition from `conditions` (unmodified, not linked into
our code; or a separate program). A GPL needs 'separate-program'. The gate checks the condition.
forbid     - never allowed, never excepted: AGPL, EUPL and source-available licences (BUSL/BSL, SSPL, Elastic, Commons Clause, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-SA).
Unknown or unlicensed fails unless an exception carries a reason. Dual-licensed (SPDX 'A OR B', or legacy 'A/B'): passes if ANY option is allowed
(the chosen option is recorded); 'A AND B' needs every side allowed; 'WITH <exception>' does not change the base licence.
attributionExempt - every OTHER chosen licence (including excepted ones) needs an attribution entry (the package name) in one of noticesFiles.
aliases    - legacy/free-text licence strings mapped to an SPDX id; the bare 'BSD License' / 'BSD' resolve to BSD-3-Clause (owner decision).
